hero.tagline: Frontend in Vue/TypeScript + backend in Go. 3+ years in fintech, own products in production — from the first line of code to the server.

about.label: 01 / About
about.line1: I cover the whole development cycle.
about.line2: 3+ years of engineering at Uzbekistan's leading fintech: built an SME product frontend from scratch — 273 applications in the first two weeks, performance 54→74%, Lighthouse CI in the pipeline, an internal MCP server for AI tools, e-imzo digital signature integration.
about.line3: And I build my own products end to end: Hamyonimda — a voice AI finance tracker — from the first line of code to the Go backend, PostgreSQL and CI/CD on my own server.

services.label: 02 / Expertise
services.title: Full-cycle engineering — from interface to infrastructure.

items.title: Frontend Engineering
items.body: Vue / Nuxt applications with complex business logic: performance, accessibility, animations, a perfect Lighthouse score.

items.title: Backend & API
items.body: Services in Go: REST APIs, PostgreSQL, payment and auth integrations. Reliable and scalable.

items.title: Telegram platforms
items.body: Bots and Mini Apps with payment processing — full products inside Telegram, from booking flows to fintech services.

items.title: Infrastructure & CI/CD
items.body: Docker, Nginx, pipelines, monitoring. The service lives in production 24/7 — and I know exactly how it feels.

projects.hamyonimda: Voice AI personal finance tracker. Speak an expense to a Telegram bot — AI parses the amount and category. Go backend, PostgreSQL, Mini App, web dashboard and CI/CD — the whole stack is mine.
projects.skale: Conversion-focused site for a Tashkent marketing agency: 3D dispersed glass hero, scroll choreography, static export.
projects.fides: Medical tourism platform for Uzbekistan: clinics, doctors, transparent pricing, end-to-end support.
